end.summary:
Practised sorting numbers as odd or even by making pairs.
Explored pairing with 7 and 247; identified that one is left over in 7.
Practised identifying the number of pairs in 7 as three pairs with one left.
Discussed 47 and was unsure whether to use the whole number or individual digits.
Zero was described as neither odd nor even twice; this was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Jiya practised making pairs to identify odd and even numbers and correctly described three pairs with one left over for 7. They mixed up the digits of 47 with the whole number, and their idea that 0 is neither odd nor even was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, practise with small groups of objects, including 0, and say whether all objects form pairs or one is left.
